== Course of events ==

By this point Dorothy had already told Glinda her whole story and made clear that her greatest wish was to return to Kansas, to Aunt Em and Uncle Henry. Glinda had explained that the Silver Shoes held the power to carry their wearer anywhere in the world in three steps, simply by clicking the heels together three times and naming the destination.

With that knowledge, Dorothy tearfully said goodbye to her companions. She then clicked the heels of the Silver Shoes together, and was instantly whirled away through the air, carried back toward the Kansas prairie.

The journey was not without cost: during the flight, the Silver Shoes were lost, so that when Dorothy arrived back on the Kansas prairie, she no longer had them with her.
